title: Rename: classes, structs, interfaces, records, and delegates
summary_line_1: Add semantic rename for C# and F# type-like declarations.
summary_line_2: Update constructors and references across real solutions with invalid-name e2e coverage.

title: Rename: enums
summary_line_1: Add semantic rename for C# and F# enum declarations.
summary_line_2: Update every type reference across real solutions and cover invalid names end to end.

title: Rename: enum members
summary_line_1: Add semantic rename for C# enum members and F# enum cases.
summary_line_2: Update declarations and all semantic usages with invalid-name e2e coverage.

title: Rename: methods, functions, local functions, and operators
summary_line_1: Add semantic rename for C# methods, functions, and operators plus their F# equivalents.
summary_line_2: Update declarations and references with invalid-name e2e coverage.

title: Rename: constructors through containing type rename
summary_line_1: Keep constructor declarations and calls correct when their containing type is renamed.
summary_line_2: Treat constructors as dependent references rather than independently renameable symbols.

title: Rename: properties and indexers
summary_line_1: Add semantic rename for C# and F# properties and indexers.
summary_line_2: Update accessors, implementations, overrides, and references across real solutions.

title: Rename: fields and events
summary_line_1: Add semantic rename for C# fields, constants, and events plus F# fields, values, and events.
summary_line_2: Update declarations and references with invalid-name e2e coverage.

title: Rename: local variables and pattern/deconstruction bindings
summary_line_1: Add semantic rename for local and pattern-bound variables in C# and F#.
summary_line_2: Cover loops, catches, deconstruction, patterns, and local bindings across their valid scopes.

title: Rename: parameters and lambda parameters
summary_line_1: Add semantic rename for parameters in methods, constructors, functions, delegates, and lambdas.
summary_line_2: Support both C# and F# parameter forms with invalid-name e2e coverage.

title: Rename: namespaces and modules
summary_line_1: Add semantic rename for C# and F# namespaces, modules, and applicable aliases.
summary_line_2: Update declarations and semantic references across real solutions.

title: Rename: generic type parameters
summary_line_1: Add semantic rename for generic type parameters in C# and F#.
summary_line_2: Support both type-level and method-level parameters with invalid-name e2e coverage.

title: Rename: aliases and type abbreviations
summary_line_1: Add safe semantic rename for C# using aliases and F# type abbreviations or module aliases.
summary_line_2: Limit support to locations exposed reliably by compiler services.

title: Rename: F# record fields
summary_line_1: Add semantic rename for F# record fields.
summary_line_2: Update declarations, construction and copy expressions, patterns, and field access sites.

title: Rename: F# discriminated union cases
summary_line_1: Add semantic rename for F# discriminated union cases.
summary_line_2: Update declarations, construction sites, and pattern matches across real solutions.

title: Rename: F# active patterns
summary_line_1: Add semantic rename for F# active patterns.
summary_line_2: Update declarations and every pattern usage site with invalid-name e2e coverage.

title: feat: update Shipwright repo fixtures for Forge after all deployment issues are resolved
summary_line_1: Synchronize Shipwright’s Forge manifest and version-output fixtures after prerequisite deployment work.
summary_line_2: Validate all fixtures with Shipwright’s test suite before closing.

title: Shipwright deployment-contract hardening checklist
summary_line_1: Bring release and IDE deployment into full Shipwright contract compliance.
summary_line_2: Harden version checks, Actions permissions and pinning, provenance, SBOMs, checksums, and trusted publishing.

title: Enforce the expected version during resolution
summary_line_1: Reject resolved binaries whose versions differ from the expected release.
summary_line_2: Surface a precise startup error under the Shipwright contract.

title: Add Zed LSP-initialize version enforcement
summary_line_1: Enforce binary compatibility during Zed’s LSP initialize handshake.
summary_line_2: Reject version mismatches under the Shipwright contract.

title: Sign + notarize the macOS binaries
summary_line_1: Developer ID sign, notarize, and staple every macOS host and sidecar binary.
summary_line_2: Retain cosign provenance alongside Apple signing.

title: Windows code signing — current position
summary_line_1: Track the unresolved path to native Windows Authenticode signing.
summary_line_2: Use package-manager trust and cosign provenance until a durable option is chosen.

title: [Feature]: F# treesitter
summary_line_1: Evaluate the newer generic tree-sitter grammar for F# parsing.
summary_line_2: Compare it with the older Neovim-focused implementation before adoption.

title: F#: completion auto-`open` insertion (FSAC parity) needs an unopened-symbol entity index
summary_line_1: Index symbols from referenced assemblies and current F# files so unopened namespaces appear in completion.
summary_line_2: Cache insertion edits so resolved completions can add the required open directive.

title: NuGet browser: finish post-install sidecar workspace reload + prerelease/restore polish
summary_line_1: Reload sidecar workspaces after NuGet install or uninstall and add prerelease and restore workflows.
summary_line_2: Later add caching, cancellation, performance coverage, and notification-ordering tests.

title: Flaky e2e: stale F# error diagnostic survives 60s after file correction (clears-diagnostics race)
summary_line_1: A flaky F# diagnostic can remain for 60 seconds after corrected content is closed and reopened.
summary_line_2: Investigate stale pull-result versioning and FCS invalidation, adding an old-version guard if the race is confirmed.

title: Sidecar listener failure is invisible: exit 0, no stderr, error only in temp log
summary_line_1: Make sidecar listener failures visible through nonzero exits and stderr diagnostics.
summary_line_2: Have the Rust host report child status and the sidecar log path when READY never arrives.

title: Deterministic sidecar IPC endpoint collides across hosts on the same workspace
summary_line_1: Generate unique sidecar IPC endpoints for concurrent hosts on one workspace.
summary_line_2: Prevent Windows pipe collisions and Unix socket stealing, with busy-pipe retry as defense in depth.

title: Sidecar spawn-time failures bypass crash backoff — unthrottled respawn storm
summary_line_1: Apply crash backoff when a sidecar fails before completing startup.
summary_line_2: Prevent semantic requests from spawning unthrottled doomed processes.

title: SidecarHost.MessageLoopAsync hot-loops on persistent transport exceptions
summary_line_1: Stop the sidecar message loop after persistent transport exceptions.
summary_line_2: Avoid hot zombie processes that consume CPU and flood logs.

title: READY echoes the requested endpoint even when the listener bound a relocated path
summary_line_1: A latent long-Unix-socket-path bug reports the requested endpoint instead of the shortened bound path.
summary_line_2: Prevent the host from connecting to the original unbound path.
component: Rust LSP host + shared .NET sidecar infrastructure

title: Sidecar solution restore broken: MessagePack 3.1.7/3.1.8 downgrade + FSharp.Core 10.1.301 violates FCS exact pin
summary_line_1: Align MessagePack versions across sidecar projects and match FSharp.Core to FCS’s exact requirement.
summary_line_2: Add dependency-consistency guards to prevent restore-blocking version drift.

title: [Feature]: .sqlproj support
summary_line_1: SharpLsp does not load SDK-style .sqlproj projects when opening a solution.
summary_line_2: Support should include SQL projects alongside C# and F# projects during solution loading.

title: C# rename returns a single whole-document TextEdit — SourceText normalization defeats granular GetTextChanges (contrary to its own comment)
summary_line_1: C# rename emits one whole-document TextEdit instead of granular symbol edits.
summary_line_2: Using unrelated SourceText instances loses change history and disrupts editor state and partial previews.

title: make _test-vsix cannot go green on Windows — Linux-shaped staging assertions + temp-dir EPERM cleanup flakes
summary_line_1: The full VSIX test gate fails on Windows because sidecar filenames are asserted without .exe and cleanup hits EPERM.
summary_line_2: Platform-aware staging assertions and retrying cleanup after watcher disposal should make the gate reliable.

title: Sidecar process-tree cleanup on Windows: no Job Object / tree kill, no parent-death watchdog
summary_line_1: Windows kills only direct sidecar children, allowing dotnet grandchildren and build workers to survive host failure.
summary_line_2: A Job Object and parent-death watchdog are needed to terminate the full process tree and release named pipes.

title: Sidecar protocol hardening: response-id correlation + health-check lock race
summary_line_1: The sidecar manager neither validates response IDs nor performs health checks without a transport lock race.
summary_line_2: Mismatched responses should force reconnection and health monitoring should track genuinely stalled requests.
functionality_subarea: IPC response correlation and health monitoring

title: F# sidecar loads only the first .fsproj discovered — multi-project F# workspaces mostly unanalyzed
summary_line_1: The F# sidecar loads only the first discovered .fsproj, leaving other projects on synthetic single-file analysis.
summary_line_2: It should load every solution project and route each file through its owning FSharpProjectOptions.

title: MSBuildInstanceSelector: exact Roslyn version equality — SDK servicing skew falls back to a known-broken registration
summary_line_1: Exact Roslyn assembly version matching rejects compatible serviced SDKs and can trigger the known broken fallback registration.
summary_line_2: SDK selection should accept a compatible minimum version or fully isolate bundled Roslyn assemblies.

title: Sidecar PATH resolution accepts .cmd/.bat/extensionless shims the spawn then cannot execute
summary_line_1: Windows PATH discovery accepts command shims that CreateProcess cannot execute and then suppresses working fallback locations.
summary_line_2: Resolution should launch a supported absolute executable or continue through the fallback chain after spawn failure.

title: Profiler: default output paths are CWD-relative and ProfilerConfig.output_directory is dead
summary_line_1: Profiler outputs default to a host-CWD-relative directory that may be unwritable, while the configured output directory is ignored.
summary_line_2: Defaults should use the workspace or user data directory and report clear write failures.

title: workspace symbols: collect_source_files follows directory junctions with no cycle detection or depth cap
summary_line_1: Workspace-symbol file discovery follows symlink or junction cycles without a visited set or depth limit.
summary_line_2: Canonical-path cycle detection and a depth cap are needed to prevent host stack overflow.

title: NuGet: packages-root prefix strip lacks a separator boundary; parse.rs scrapes MSBuild XML line-wise
summary_line_1: NuGet path matching can confuse sibling package roots, and project XML is parsed with fragile line scanning.
summary_line_2: Boundary-aware paths and a real MSBuild or XML document model should replace both behaviors.

title: native_paths_equal is ASCII-only case-insensitive — NTFS is case-insensitive across Unicode
summary_line_1: VFS path equality folds ASCII only, so equivalent non-ASCII NTFS paths can miss the live buffer.
summary_line_2: Use operating-system case comparison or suitable Unicode folding and cover non-ASCII fixture paths.

title: Sidecar shutdown acknowledgement is never sent — handler cancels the token the response write depends on
summary_line_1: The sidecar cancels the token used to write its shutdown acknowledgement, so graceful shutdown always times out.
summary_line_2: It should flush the acknowledgement before cancellation and hard termination.

title: Decompiled-source temp files are shared across sidecar processes and written without sharing — Windows write race
summary_line_1: Concurrent C# sidecars share and exclusively overwrite the same decompiled-source temp paths.
summary_line_2: Process-scoped paths or atomic write-and-rename semantics should prevent Windows races and partial reads.

title: C# parity: textDocument/signatureHelp is F#-only — Roslyn sidecar has no handler, host answers null
summary_line_1: C# signature-help requests return null because only the F# sidecar implements the shared route.
summary_line_2: The Roslyn sidecar should produce the shared SignatureHelpResult and the C# end-to-end test should require it.

title: [Feature]: MacOS support
summary_line_1: The VS Code extension is unavailable for macOS.
summary_line_2: Publishing and packaging should support macOS as a language-agnostic editor platform.

title: [Bug]: Completion inserts duplicate method name after . (e.g. Console.WriteLineWriteLine)
summary_line_1: Selecting a C# member completion after a dot appends the method name to itself.
summary_line_2: Completion edits should replace the active identifier range instead of duplicating the selected item.

title: Test Explorer: MSTest tests not discovered (dotnet test --list-tests emits bare DisplayName, not FQN)
summary_line_1: MSTest tests are omitted because text scraping expects dotted names while dotnet test emits bare display names.
summary_line_2: Discovery should consume TestCase.FullyQualifiedName through VSTest or another structured result source.

title: Closure dedup is case-insensitive on case-sensitive filesystems, silently dropping includes
summary_line_1: Case-insensitive closure deduplication silently drops distinct include files on case-sensitive filesystems.
summary_line_2: Comparer behavior should match the actual volume and report every skipped already-visited include.

title: Windows: Solution Explorer / workspaceSymbols serve stale data after rename (3 e2e failures)
summary_line_1: Windows Solution Explorer and workspaceSymbols can show the previous symbol name after unsaved or rapid renames.
summary_line_2: Instrument VFS/path resolution and refresh ordering; add generation-aware responses if that race is confirmed.
component: VS Code extension + Rust LSP host

title: Branch protection on main requires no functional test job — a fully red test run can merge
summary_line_1: Branch protection on main requires no functional or coverage test jobs, so fully failing changes can merge.
summary_line_2: Required checks should include Rust, .NET, VS Code, Windows, and coverage jobs with verified skip behavior.

title: [Bug]: C# Sidecar Initialization Fails Permanently When Opening a Projectless Directory
summary_line_1: Opening a projectless directory leaves the C# sidecar permanently uninitialized when a C# file is created later.
summary_line_2: Directory initialization should succeed provisionally and lazily open single-file mode on the first C# document.

title: vscode-languageclient v10 breaks restartServer: client never returns to Running
summary_line_1: vscode-languageclient 10 prevents restartServer from returning the client and status bar to Running.
summary_line_2: Investigate vscode-languageclient v10 restart readiness and stop-start sequencing while retaining the completed logging API migration.

title: Flaky e2e: profiler object-graph test fails when the baseline heap dump has no StringBuilder instances
summary_line_1: The profiler object-graph test races heap capture against StringBuilder allocation and fails intermittently.
summary_line_2: A readiness signal or bounded polling should synchronize the baseline dump without weakening the assertion.
